data.long_meaning: The one who is content and satisfied. The name Razeem carries the meaning “Contentment, Satisfaction” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Razeem usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment, satisfaction and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Thus, the name "Razeem" serves as a constant reminder of the importance of nurturing the relationship with Allah and the significance of seeking His satisfaction and contentment in all aspects of life.
